discoveryMethod.structuredTraversal: Every selected JSON/JSONL artifact is parsed and recursively traversed; dictionary keys and dictionary values are both inspected
discoveryMethod.identityMatching: Evidence-based MR-CAP-001, MR-IMPL-001, ENTRY_MR-CAP-001, TEST-MR-CAP-001-* and existing related identifiers; generic schema keys are not identities
discoveryMethod.semanticPipeline: KEY, VALUE, and BOTH matches enter one classification/validation pipeline; BOTH is deduplicated by semantic record identity
discoveryMethod.failClosed: Unknown current-authoritative keyed semantics become UNCLASSIFIED_CURRENT_AUTHORITY and fail
